= Union Alphabet =

The '''Union Alphabet''' ({{lang|san|Unija Alfabet}}) is the official writing system of the [[Union of Zhensanov]], designed specifically to represent all sounds in the [[Zhensanovian Languages]], particularly [[Sanovic]].{{Infobox writing system
| name = Union Alphabet
| type = Alphabet
| languages = [[Sanovic]], [[Zhensanovian Languages]]
| time = 20th century to present
| fam1 = [[Zhensanovian Scripts]]
| children = None
| unicode = U+10000 to U+100FF
| iso15924 = ZSAN
}}

== History ==

The Union Alphabet was developed in the mid-20th century as part of the [[Union Language Committee]]'s efforts to create a unified writing system for all Zhensanovian languages. The alphabet was designed to:
* Accommodate all phonemes in Zhensanovian languages
* Be easily learnable
* Support both traditional and digital media
* Maintain cultural neutrality

== Structure ==

The Union Alphabet consists of 45 base letters and various diacritics. It is written left-to-right.

=== Ejective Letters ===

Ejective consonants are marked with an apostrophe (ʼ) after the base letter:
* pʼ [pʼ]
* tʼ [tʼ]
* kʼ [kʼ]
* sʼ [sʼ]
* ʃʼ [ʃʼ]

=== Diacritics ===

The Union Alphabet uses several diacritics:
* Acute accent (´) - marks stress
* Dot above (˙) - marks palatalization
* Ring above (˚) - marks nasalization
* Tilde (˜) - marks vowel length

== Usage ==

The Union Alphabet is used for:
* Official government documents
* Education materials
* Public signage
* Media publications
* Digital communications

== Typography ==

The Union Alphabet has both print and cursive forms. The cursive script is particularly important for handwriting and calligraphy.

=== Digital Representation ===

The Union Alphabet is encoded in Unicode in the Private Use Area (PUA):
* Base range: U+10000 to U+100FF
* Extended range: U+10100 to U+101FF (for special characters and diacritics)
